Specification: This module defines a recursive bitwise AND operation over integers and introduces an infix operator `&` as a wrapper around that recursive definition. The implementation is intended to be used with a Java operator override in TLC, as explained by the comments, and the comments also document the expected TLC behavior when the override is present or missing. The specification is not a transition-system model with variables or temporal properties; instead, it provides a mathematical/operator-level definition of bitwise conjunction using arithmetic decomposition by powers of two.
IfThenElse: IF m = 0 THEN 0 ELSE exp * ((x \div exp) % 2) * ((y \div exp) % 2) + And(x,y,n+1,m \div 2)
